embed.title: !maxbattle
embed.description: Alerts for Dynamax and Gigantamax battles at Power Spots. Track by boss, by level, or every level.

fields.name: By boss
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}maxbattle charizard`
`{{prefix}}maxbattle kingler snorlax d:1500` — any of these, within 1.5 km
`{{prefix}}maxbattle charmander+` — a trailing `+` adds its evolutions
`{{prefix}}maxbattle charmander+ squirtle+ fire` — `gen:N` and type names narrow a list of named bosses

fields.name: By level
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}maxbattle level:3` — 3-star battles
`{{prefix}}maxbattle level:1-5` — a range
`{{prefix}}maxbattle level:7` — Gigantamax battles (`level:8` = Legendary Gigantamax)
`{{prefix}}maxbattle everything` — every level

fields.name: Filters
fields.value:
`gmax` — Gigantamax only, e.g. `{{prefix}}maxbattle everything gmax` or `{{prefix}}maxbattle charizard gmax`
`move:mud-slap` — only bosses with this move (move names as shown in the game)
`form:<name>` — one form of a named boss

fields.name: Where
fields.value:
`d:1500` — within 1500 m of your location
`d:500 location:home` — measure from a saved location (`{{prefix}}help location`)
`area:city_centre` — only in these areas instead of your `{{prefix}}area` list

fields.name: Message options
Remove and mute
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}maxbattle remove charizard`
`{{prefix}}maxbattle remove level:3`
`{{prefix}}maxbattle remove everything`
`{{prefix}}maxbattle remove id:9` — one rule by the id shown in `{{prefix}}tracked`
`{{prefix}}maxbattle mute id:9 duration:2h` — pause one rule without deleting it (`{{prefix}}help mute`)
